attchmntText: Jullundur Motor Agency (Delhi) Limited has informed the Exchange about Buyback
voiceSummary: Jullundur Motor Agency Delhi Limited approved standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The board also approved a proposal for a buyback of up to 20,00,000 equity shares at Rs. 112 per share, totaling Rs. 22,40,00,000. This buyback is subject to shareholder approval and follows the Board approval route under Section 68(2)(b) of the Companies Act, 2013. The record date for eligibility is November 18, 2026. Promoters intend not to participate. Corporate Professionals Capital Private Limited is appointed as the merchant banker. The company fixed the record date for ascertaining shareholder eligibility. Financial results show a net profit after tax of Rs. 672.03 lakhs for the half year ended September 30, 2026.

attchmntText: Submission of Board Resolution and Public Announcement for Buyback of equity shares of MedPlus Health Services Limited (the  Company ) through open market route.
voiceSummary: Medplus Health Services Limited has approved a proposal to buy back fully paid-up equity shares through the open market route. The buyback is for an aggregate amount not exceeding Rs. 130.00 Crores. The maximum buyback price is set at Rs. 750 per equity share. The face value of each share is Rs. 2. The buyback excludes promoters and persons in control of the company. The offer opens on November 13, 2026. The buyback period closes within 66 working days from the opening date. At least 75 percent of the maximum buyback size must be utilized. The company will use its securities premium account, free reserves, and internal accruals for this purpose. The public announcement was made on November 09, 2026.

attchmntText: VRL Logistics Limited has informed the Exchange about post Buyback Public Announcement
voiceSummary: VRL Logistics Limited submitted the post buyback public announcement to BSE Limited and NSE on November 12, 2026. The company executed a buyback of not exceeding 87,50,000 fully paid-up equity shares. Each share has a face value of Rs. 10. This represents 5% of the existing total paid-up equity capital. The buyback was conducted through the tender offer route. The price was Rs. 320 per equity share. The aggregate maximum amount did not exceed Rs. 28,000 Lakhs. The announcement was published in Financial Express, Jansatta, and Vijayavani on November 12, 2026. This filing complies with the Securities and Exchange Board of India Buyback Regulations, 2018.

attchmntText: ICICI Securities Limited has submitted a copy of the Letter of Offer of IIFL Capital Services Limited to the Exchange.
voiceSummary: ICICI Securities Limited, acting as the manager to the open offer, disclosed that 45,35,712 equity shares, constituting 4.53% of the offer size, have been tendered in the open offer escrow demat account. The open offer is for the acquisition of up to 10,01,44,112 fully paid-up equity shares of face value of INR 2 each of IIFL Capital Services Limited by FIH Mauritius Investments Ltd along with HWIC Asia Fund. The tendered shares were received as per the open offer escrow demat account statement from Ventura Securities Limited as at 13:52:50 on November 12, 2026. The equity shares tendered by public shareholders are subject to validation and verification of the submission of a complete set of documents. The number of equity shares tendered may differ from the number of equity shares which will be accepted by the acquirer in the open offer.

attchmntText: Sejal Glass Limited has informed the exchange about signing and execution of Business Transfer Agreement for purchase and acquisition of the business undertaking of M/s. Magnumtuff India Private Limited.
voiceSummary: Sejal Glass Limited signed and executed a Business Transfer Agreement with Magnumtuff India Private Limited and its Promoters for the slump sale acquisition of their business undertaking relating to the manufacturing, sale, and supply of Architectural Glass and Automotive Glass. The acquisition includes manufacturing facilities in Belgaum, Karnataka, along with technical know-how, intellectual property rights, brand name, goodwill, customer and vendor relationships, books and records, employees, and other assets. Upon closing, the Company will execute a Sale Deed for the immovable properties comprising the land and building of the factory premises. The acquisition is expected to strengthen the Company's manufacturing capabilities and expand its business presence in the Architectural Glass and Automotive Glass segment. This intimation was filed under Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR Regulations, 2015.

attchmntText: Rochana Tarang Jain has Submitted to the Exchange a copy of Disclosure under Regulation 10 (5) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011.
voiceSummary: Varroc Engineering Limited received an intimation from Rochana Tarang Jain regarding the proposed acquisition of 5,000 equity shares from Mr. Tarang Jain, the Promoter and Chairman and Managing Director. The transfer is by way of gift between the promoter and his immediate relative, the spouse. The acquisition is valued at NIL. The transaction represents 0.00% of the total paid-up equity share capital. The proposed date of acquisition is on or after June 29, 2026. This inter-se transfer is exempt from making an open offer under Regulation 10(1)(a)(i) of SEBI SAST Regulations. The transfer is for private family arrangement. Mr. Tarang Jain’s shareholding will decrease from 6,07,29,800 shares to 6,07,24,800 shares. Mrs. Rochana Tarang Jain’s shareholding will increase from 0 to 5,000 shares.

attchmntText: Motilal Oswal Financial Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 954715 securities pursuant to ESOP/ESPS at its meeting held on November 13, 2026
voiceSummary: Motilal Oswal Financial Services Limited has filed a notice regarding the allotment of equity shares pursuant to the exercise of Employee Stock Options. The Finance Committee of the Board of Directors approved the allotment of 9,54,715 equity shares to option grantees on November 13, 2026. The shares were allotted under four specific schemes. ESOP Scheme VII received 500 shares. ESOP Scheme VIII received 1,23,501 shares. ESOP Scheme IX received 7,98,064 shares. ESOP Scheme X received 32,650 shares. The total number of shares allotted is 9,54,715. These equity shares will rank pari-passu with the existing equity shares of the company in all respects. The committee meeting commenced at 05:00 p.m. and concluded at 05:25 p.m. The company secretary and compliance officer, Kailash Purohit, signed the communication. The security code for BSE Limited is 532892. The symbol for National Stock Exchange of India Limited is MOTILALOFS.

attchmntText: Kaynes Technology India Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Kaynes Technology India Limited approved un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board approved a Joint Venture Agreement with Toyokawa Techno Private Limited to manufacture Thin-Film Transistor Display Modules. The Board also proposed the voluntary strike-off of subsidiary Kaynes Embedded Systems Private Limited, subject to statutory formalities. The auditor's review noted restatements for prior period errors. The consolidated results include a share of net loss from associate Mixx Technologies, Inc. The meeting concluded at 21:30 IST on November 14, 2026.

attchmntText: Stallion India Fluorochemicals Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 13, 2026, titled "STALLION INDIA FLUOROCHEMICALS LIMITED Q2 & H1 FY27 FINANCIAL RESULTS & STRATEGIC UPDATE".
voiceSummary: Stallion India Fluorochemicals Limited filed a press release regarding its Q2 and H1 FY27 financial results. The company reported total income of 13,937.33 lakh rupees for Q2 FY27, a 31.79 percent year-on-year increase. H1 FY27 total income rose 22.07 percent to 26,404.90 lakh rupees. Operating EBITDA before ESOP provision was 1,583.54 lakh rupees in Q2 and 4,110.32 lakh rupees in H1. Operating PAT before ESOP provision stood at 1,196.21 lakh rupees in Q2 and 3,052.78 lakh rupees in H1. The company noted a non-cash ESOP provision of 950.92 lakh rupees for H1 FY27. Additionally, the Khalapur High-Purity Helium Facility commenced operations in September 2026. The firm entered a strategic partnership with Sharjah Oxygen Company L.L.C. SP for liquid helium sourcing.

attchmntText: Yuken India Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Yuken India Limited submitted the newspaper publication of un-audited financial results for the second quarter ended September 30, 2026. The advertisements were published on November 15, 2026, in the Financial Express and Hosadigantha newspapers. The company also announced the convening of its Annual General Meeting on December 18, 2026, at its registered office in Bengaluru. The meeting will consider the adoption of audited financial statements for the year ended March 31, 2026. The board recommended a final dividend of Rs. 10 per equity share. The meeting will also address the re-appointment of retiring directors and auditors. The notice for the general meeting was issued on November 15, 2026.
